topic: Mobile UX, Responsive Patterns, and Cross-Platform Design
learningObjectives: Apply mobile-first principles to interface layouts.
Adapt navigation and interactions for different device contexts.
Design consistent experiences across mobile, tablet, and desktop screens.

activities.title: Responsive Pattern Map
activities.instruction: Explore how layout, navigation, content, and controls adapt across device sizes.

content.concept: Responsive design adapts layouts, navigation, controls, and content priorities to different screen sizes and contexts.
content.tip: Select each pattern to compare its mobile, tablet, and desktop behavior.

items.label: Navigation
items.description: Desktop navigation may collapse into a menu or bottom navigation on smaller screens.

items.label: Content Layout
items.description: Multi-column layouts can become a single-column mobile layout.

items.label: Images
items.description: Images can resize or crop differently based on available space.

items.label: Controls
items.description: Controls should remain usable and appropriately sized on touch devices.

items.label: Typography
items.description: Text sizes and line lengths can adapt to maintain readability.

activities.title: Mobile Navigation Lab
activities.instruction: Select an appropriate navigation pattern for each mobile task.

content.concept: Mobile navigation patterns should prioritize frequently used tasks while keeping important destinations discoverable.
content.tip: Consider frequency, discoverability, available space, and task importance.

scenarios.question: A mobile app has five frequently used primary destinations.
scenarios.explanation: Frequently used primary destinations can remain accessible through bottom navigation.

scenarios.question: An app contains many secondary settings that users access occasionally.
scenarios.explanation: Secondary destinations can be grouped to avoid overwhelming primary navigation.

scenarios.question: A mobile task requires users to switch frequently between two major sections.
options: Hide both sections in deep menus
scenarios.explanation: Frequent switching benefits from easy access to the relevant destinations.

activities.title: Breakpoint Builder
activities.instruction: Arrange how a layout should adapt from mobile to tablet and desktop.

content.concept: Breakpoints allow layouts to reorganize when available space changes significantly.
content.tip: Focus on structural changes rather than simply shrinking every element.

activities.title: Touch Target Lab
activities.instruction: Adjust the control size and spacing to create a comfortable touch interface.

content.concept: Touch interfaces require controls with sufficient size and spacing to support accurate interaction on smaller screens.
content.tip: Increase target size and spacing when controls are difficult to tap accurately.

scenarios.description: Small target that may be difficult to tap accurately.
Comfortable target size for many touch interactions.
Large target with generous interaction area.
